description: This file is a Java test class for the ThingQueryCommandAdapter component, containing unit tests for encoding and decoding various 'thing' query commands such as retrieving a thing, access control list, attributes, features, definitions, and multiple things, as well as handling unknown commands. It relies on JUnit and is part of a larger codebase related to Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter.

classes.name: ThingQueryCommandAdapterTest
classes.description: This class contains unit tests for the ThingQueryCommandAdapter, verifying conversion between Adaptable objects and specific query command objects in various scenarios, including retrieval of things, ACLs, attributes, features, definitions, and handling unknown commands.
